event_name: Date 24 July 2022 Time 16:03 2022 FRENCH GRAND PRIX 21 - 24 July 2022 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
offence: Breach of Article 34.14 a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed the video evidence and determined that the team released the car into the path of car 23 (ALB), as a result of which ALB had to heavily brake to avoid a collision.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 55 Unsafe Release
